message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"The best numerical result so far is the 16-bit LUT (SQNR 82.1 dB) but its area is 1584.6 um^2; the 14-bit LUT gives 72.8 dB at 1346.5 um^2, a much better area/quality tradeoff. Since increase_precision and increase_table_capacity have no legal unvisited neighbors, decreasing precision is the only available move that can reduce mapped area while retaining acceptable SQNR."}
